<thought>To obtain the precursors, I need the retrosynthetic template that converts a sulfonamide back to an aromatic amine and a phenyl‑sulfonyl chloride. The available functional‑group list includes “alkyl halide” (which can cover the S‑Cl bond) and “sulfonamides”. By searching the template catalog for a reaction that breaks an alkyl halide and forms a sulfonamide, I can retrieve the appropriate template ID and then apply it to the target molecule to get the precursor SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
